title: Kitten reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#f5a742'/>
  <!-- lighter tummy -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='17' fill='#f5a742'/>
  <!-- inner face lighter -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='12' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='36,36 32,20 46,32' fill='#f5a742'/>
  <polygon points='64,36 68,20 54,32' fill='#f5a742'/>
  <!-- inner ears pink -->
  <polygon points='37,34 34,24 44,32' fill='#ff9bce'/>
  <polygon points='63,34 66,24 56,32' fill='#ff9bce'/>
  <!-- eyes shining -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='47' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3ee0c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='47' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3ee0c0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,52 48,54 52,54' fill='#ff7ca8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M48 54 Q50 57 52 54' stroke='#c26b2c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='32' y1='50' x2='42' y2='52' stroke='#fff1c9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='54' x2='42' y2='54' stroke='#fff1c9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='50' x2='58' y2='52' stroke='#fff1c9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='54' x2='58' y2='54' stroke='#fff1c9' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- book bottom half -->
  <polygon points='30,78 50,72 50,88 30,92' fill='#6a5bff'/>
  <polygon points='70,78 50,72 50,88 70,92' fill='#9b8cff'/>
  <!-- book pages edge -->
  <polygon points='48,73 50,72 50,88 48,87' fill='#fff1c9'/>
  <polygon points='52,73 50,72 50,88 52,87' fill='#fff1c9'/>
  <!-- book cover lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='79' x2='46' y2='75' stroke='#c7c0ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='83' x2='46' y2='79' stroke='#c7c0ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='75' x2='65' y2='79' stroke='#b0a8ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='79' x2='65' y2='83' stroke='#b0a8ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='74' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='74' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- paw toe lines -->
  <path d='M34 72 Q37 76 40 72' stroke='#f0b85a' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 72 Q63 76 66 72' stroke='#f0b85a' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- tail curled -->
  <path d='M28 82 Q14 78 16 64 Q18 56 26 60' stroke='#f5a742' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 82 Q14 78 16 64 Q18 56 26 60' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
